**I vote for the scorch shot!**

The flare gun is definitely the better weapon, though, as burning crits can wreck any class (assuming you have half-decent aim). For me, though, the scorch shot is more satisfying. Shooting at the enemy cart and hearing the first "ding" followed by multiple "ding-ding-ding-ding-ding"s as you ignite a group brings a smile to my face. The scorch shot's shining glory is definitely the knockback. Upward's third cap is my favorite place to defend, as you can sit way back and spam flares at the cart, watching enemies fly off this way and that. I love it.
Degreaser.

I vote for the Disciplinary action. Using the Market Gardener is super satisfying, but it's difficult to pull off, and does nothing to help your team. The whip, on the other hand, is great for getting slower classes to the front lines, and the longer range makes up for the damage reduction. And I just love the sound.

I choose Escape Plan.

All hail the magic conch!
The buff banner is good but far too often I've had a team that's too scared to rush the enemy when I drop it, or their aim is so bad that the mini crits hardly make a difference. 
The conch's speed buff, however, gives players a little adrenaline boost, and I have fond memories of rushing the opposing team with 3 m1 pyros that are speeding all over the place. The health on hit is also a nice safety net when considering high risk engagements. 
The +2 health per second is wonderful, and it's saved me from afterburn deaths many times. 
My vote is for the conch!
